# kintone_app (Resource)

Manages an app and its general settings. Omitted settings retain their remote values. Do not leave unrelated preview changes on this app: deployment includes those changes. Destroy only removes Terraform state; delete the app manually. Creation failures require manual inspection before retrying.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kintone_app" "example" {
  name        = "Customer requests"
  description = "Managed with Terraform"
  theme       = "BLUE"

  title_field = {
    selection_mode = "AUTO"
    # Omit field_code: state contains the code selected by kintone.
  }

  number_precision = {
    total_digits   = 16
    decimal_places = 4
    rounding_mode  = "HALF_EVEN"
  }
  comments_enabled = true
}

# Omitted settings retain their existing values. Do not leave unrelated preview
# changes on this app: deployment includes them. Destroy removes only Terraform
# state; app deletion requires manual cleanup in kintone.
```

## Ownership and recovery

Omitting a setting, including removing it from HCL, preserves its remote value. Use explicit values to
manage settings; use an empty description to clear it. Nested settings preserve omitted children.

In AUTO title mode, omit `field_code` from HCL. State contains kintone's selected code, which can change
when switching from MANUAL. In MANUAL mode, use a nonempty code for an existing field; this resource does
not create form fields.

Do not leave unrelated preview changes on a managed app. Deploying a Terraform change also publishes
those drafts. Reads use live settings. Read errors retain state, including 404, because a missing live
app may be an undeployed app from a failed creation. Verify access and deployment status before removing
state. Space and thread placement can be supplied only at creation; later changes produce an error.

If creation fails, note the app ID and inspect the app before retrying. Terraform can retain tainted
state and plan replacement even when the original app still exists. To retain a deployed app, reconcile
its settings, remove the failed Terraform binding if present, then import that app and review a plan
with matching HCL. A preview-only app must first be inspected and deployed manually or cleaned up
manually. If no ID was returned, inspect kintone for the intended app name before creating another app.
For a failed update, inspect preview and live settings and refresh before retrying. The provider does
not automatically resume creation or revert drafts.

Destroy removes only the Terraform binding and reports a manual-cleanup warning. Delete unwanted apps
in kintone yourself. Deployment polling has a five-minute client deadline; v0.1.0 exposes no timeout
attributes.

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) App name (1 to 64 characters).

### Optional

- `bulk_deletion_enabled` (Boolean) Whether bulk record deletion is enabled.
- `comments_enabled` (Boolean) Whether record comments are enabled.
- `description` (String) App description, up to 10000 characters. An explicit empty string clears it.
- `first_month_of_fiscal_year` (Number) First fiscal month, from 1 to 12.
- `inline_record_editing_enabled` (Boolean) Whether inline record editing is enabled.
- `number_precision` (Attributes) Number calculation and display precision. Omitted children are preserved. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--number_precision))
- `record_duplication_enabled` (Boolean) Whether record duplication is enabled.
- `space_id` (String) Normal-space ID, configured only at creation. Omission preserves placement, including after import. Changes are rejected.
- `theme` (String) App theme: WHITE, RED, BLUE, GREEN, YELLOW, or BLACK.
- `thread_id` (String) Thread ID within the space, configured only at creation. Requires space_id. Changes are rejected.
- `thumbnails_enabled` (Boolean) Whether record attachment thumbnails are shown.
- `title_field` (Attributes) Record title settings. In AUTO mode, omit field_code and observe the selected code in state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--title_field))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App ID. Also used for import.
- `revision` (String) Live settings revision as a string.

<a id="nestedatt--number_precision"></a>
### Nested Schema for `number_precision`

Optional:

- `decimal_places` (Number) Decimal places, from 0 to 10.
- `rounding_mode` (String) HALF_EVEN, UP, or DOWN.
- `total_digits` (Number) Total digits, from 1 to 30.


<a id="nestedatt--title_field"></a>
### Nested Schema for `title_field`

Optional:

- `field_code` (String) Nonempty field code for MANUAL mode. Must be omitted in AUTO mode; state contains the automatically selected code.
- `selection_mode` (String) AUTO or MANUAL. Omission retains the current selection mode.

## Import

Import an already deployed app by ID. HCL must agree with its current settings for an empty plan.

```shell
# Import an already deployed app by its ID. Match HCL to the existing settings.
terraform import kintone_app.example 123
```
